description: Authenticity of communication sessions is not verified through cryptographic mechanisms. This signal indicates that session hijacking or man-in-the-middle attacks may be possible.
applicability: Applicable to all authenticated communication sessions. Includes TLS certificate validation, session token protection, and mutual authentication requirements.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through session authentication configuration review, certificate validation testing, and mutual authentication verification.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 - System and Communications Protection
32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
